test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following Venn diagram, the hexagon stands for 'police officers', the pentagon stands for 'graduates', the circle stands for 'females', and the square stands for 'Indians'. The given numbers represent the number of persons in that particular category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85b112ff2103f94f6c40d7bbf9e2ba02019c53b5e80b5e0ec322400f1679c732.png] 

How many Indian police officers are graduates but NOT females?
solution:
• The shaded part represents Indian police officers who are graduates but NOT females.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0466a67f9aad73eac3ef14a3afc60e9a5d56de87a04003244dcb51a4b49557b.png] 

 
• The number representing Indian police officers who are graduates but NOT females = 11

Hence, ‘11’ is the correct answer.
